tools.name: Agents Runtime Flow Benchmark
tools.description: Runs controlled live-agent runtime-flow benchmark scenarios for risky scaffold execution changes, including scripted flows and autonomous hypothetical delivery tasks, using real `codex exec` tool calls with the default `gpt-5.4-mini` + `medium` baseline and emitting JSON results for pass/fail, timing, tool usage, tool success rate, required/forbidden command matching, retries, accuracy, and context size. Autonomous scenarios should discover operations from AGENTS.md and this catalog and use `.agents/agents` wrappers rather than reading `.agents/scripts/*.py` internals.
when_to_use: After changing governed command routing, runtime registry behavior, or rule/spec visibility
When a risky execution-flow change needs empirical regression measurement beyond smoke checks
When comparing scaffold execution behavior with the standard mini baseline profile
When validating that autonomous prompts discover wrapper-first operations from AGENTS.md and tools.json without explicit scenario command hints

commands.name: list
commands.description: List available controlled benchmark scenarios

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show one scenario contract, scope, and context artifacts

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run one or more scenarios and emit structured JSON results

tools.output: JSON benchmark result payload with scenario metrics, observed tool usage, tool_success_rate, required and forbidden command checks, checks_total, checks_passed, accuracy, context_bytes, prompt_bytes, declared benchmark profile, and stable saved snapshots under .agents/benchmarks/current-results.json and .agents/benchmarks/<pack-id>-latest.json when --save is used
workflow: 1. Run benchmark list or show to select the right scenario pack
2. For autonomous scenarios, discover operations from AGENTS.md and tools.json and execute via `.agents/agents` wrappers instead of `.agents/scripts/*.py` internals
3. Run benchmark run with the default mini profile or an explicit override
4. Compare pass/fail, timing, retries, tool_success_rate, accuracy, and context_bytes against prior runs

tools.critical_rule: A governed product change is not valid unless the session exists under docs/plans before product edits. Do not reuse unrelated fixture sessions, do not create sessions outside docs/plans, and do not create tasks already marked done.
options: --feature-id: Mandatory roadmap feature identifier (for example F-01)
--parent-spec: Mandatory parent spec id or file under docs/arc/SPECS/
--child-spec: Optional existing child spec id or file to link; does not create a spec artifact
--spec-child/--spec-lite: Creates a new local child-spec artifact; do not combine with --child-spec
--quick: Registers quick task rapida na sessao ativa
--into-session: Reuse an existing session under docs/plans/ only
